unit: words of the whole file, as `LC_ALL=C wc -w` counts them: a SKILL.md keyed by its skill's directory, frontmatter included, and a role file beside it keyed `<skill>/<file>`
raise: only in the commit that needs it, recorded in `raises` as {"from": <old>, "to": <new>, "why": "<the sentence skill-retro Step 4 asks for>"}; `skill-lint.py --against <ref>` fails a rise without one

skill-retro.why: Steps 2, 4 and 6 now name the `raises` entry, the `--against` run that holds it, and that a new file's budget rises from 0, which the linter and pool-run both check

pr-harden.why: State told a session running elsewhere to EnterWorktree into the checkout, and in #607 and PR 3787 the tool refused a checkout outside the session's git repository. State now says that there the gate, run in the session's directory, reads no entry keyed on the checkout, so each write is still keyed --cwd on the checkout and the report says so (+32), and Step 0's 'the Stop gate will not let the turn end' is scoped to where it reads the entry (+5). That is guidance, not enforcement. The paragraph's 'anticipated from KEY="$(pwd -P)" and not yet observed' moves to evidence.md beside the 2026-10-14 gate measurement (-8)

pr-harden/fixer.md.why: the fixer runs its mutation probes before the build green reports on, because in #407 and #607 a probe run after that build left a failures="1" surefire report that the orchestrator's step-5 spot-check read, each time costing a re-run

pr-harden/reviewer.md.why: the reviewer's two standing rules, the JSON it returns and what makes a finding blocking move here from SKILL.md byte for byte, beneath a new header that tells it to read the file first and what its brief carries, as pr-harden 0.36.0 moved the fixer's and the verifier's, once role-file-check's wave 1 passed (2026-09-28). The header and SKILL.md's pointer are new text, so pr-harden grows by both, for a reviewer that reads these rules as written instead of the orchestrator's paraphrase of them, which is what wave 1's briefs carried

resolve-ticket/refuter.md.why: the plan refuter's seven questions, the JSON it returns and the rule every objection must meet move here from SKILL.md byte for byte, beneath a new header that tells it to read the file first and what its brief carries, the shape pr-harden 0.36.0 gave the fixer and the verifier, once role-file-check's wave 1 passed (2026-09-28). The header and SKILL.md's pointer are new text, so resolve-ticket grows by both, for a refuter that reads its questions as written

resolve-ticket.why: Step 5: after a mutation probe, rebuild the module it compiled before anything runs the restored code from target/ or cites its reports, because in #250 and TRUNK-6826 a restored probe's mutant, still compiled in target/classes, was run: by two probe runs and by a Jetty start

pr-review.why: Step 4's length rule gains one sentence: a finding that rests on something outside the PR links it where it is named, and the link is not counted, because on openmrs-core PR #6693 (2026-10-19) an inline comment cited '34 of sihsalus's ranges' with no link, taking the name as known from an earlier round, and the author searched, landed on sihsalus/sihsalus-core, which returns 404, and had to ask what it was, though the data was public in sihsalus/sihsalus-content; leaving the link uncounted keeps the 60-word cap from being a reason to drop one

pr-review/posting.md.why: the third gate line states that link rule beside the length it amends, so a local run checks it before posting; the rule itself lives in SKILL.md because the @claude review Action loads that file alone
